invariants.rationale: It is common to check for null before processing a List parameter, as is done at the beginning of the method.
The method is designed to return 0.0 if orders is null or orders is empty, so these scenarios are anticipated at entry.
orders must either be null or a valid List instance.
If orders is not null, its size cannot be negative.
It is typical for a list of orders to contain only non-null elements; otherwise, validation or processing may fail.
